models.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
models.vramBasis: FP16 weights plus context and runtime budget

notes: A serving record requires healthy GPU-A. With no healthy GPUs models is empty.
Other fitting Qwen2.5 models are on_request, have null endpoint and acceptsRequests=false.
vramGb is a conservative sizing budget, not measured memory consumption.
Price per 1M output tokens is computed only from fresh live hourly rates and observed real usage throughput. Null means insufficient evidence.
Call the public endpoint with the canonical modelId. The private legacy vLLM alias is an implementation detail.
